say:1:1121161001:1.text: I understand that <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Talene have noble reasons for their plans.
say:1:1121161001:1.male: I understand that <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Talene have noble reasons for their plans.
say:1:1121161001:1.female: I understand that <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Talene have noble reasons for their plans.

say:2:1121161002:1.text: I just... don't want to believe it. The sacred Deer Spirit statue tainted by a Hypogean... Will the people of Ivoryshade, who've only just begun to open their hearts, shut them just as tightly as before?
say:2:1121161002:1.source_cn: 我只是……不想去相信。神圣美丽的鹿灵雕像居然会被恶魔玷...

say:3:1121161003:1.text: That is not a decision you can make for them.
say:3:1121161003:1.source_cn: 那并非你可以替他们做出的选择。

say:5:1121161005:1.text: If this is truly the work of a Hypogean, then I shouldn't hesitate! I'll speak with the elders and prepare for the worst.
say:5:1121161005:1.source_cn: 如果这真的是恶魔所为，那么我也不该再有丝毫犹豫！我会和...

say:6:1121161006:1.text: Then it seems I need not say more.
say:6:1121161006:1.source_cn: 看来，不需要我多置喙了。
